g.text: Objective: the site continuous integration (CI) workflow proves, on every push to master, that the commit installs, lints, type-checks and passes its tests before any page is built.

text.tspan: a newer push cancels the running workflow
the workflow stops with an error
a failing step stops the job; nothing is deployed

g.text: the base address of the site is normalised

text.tspan: the commit of master, installed, linted, type-checked and tested, handed to bot site

g.text: the site continuous integration (CI) workflow starts and installs the dependencies
the install fails [a dependency cannot be installed]
the style check fails [a lint error]
the type check fails [a type error]

text.tspan: the build normalises the base address of the site
